issue: Must a prisoner file a notice of appeal from the amended criminal judgment, rather than seek a certificate of appealability, to challenge the court's choice of remedy after granting relief under 28 U.S.C. § 2255?

sides.position: A notice of appeal (NOA) from the amended criminal judgment is required to challenge the remedy chosen under § 2255(b). The excerpts do not identify the opposing side's circuits or holding.
cases: United States v. Hadden, 475 F.3d 652 (4th Cir. 2007)
Ajan v. United States, 731 F.3d 629 (6th Cir. 2013)

quote: Both sides note that the circuits are split on whether a prisoner must file a NOA from the amended criminal judgment or a COA when assailing the judge's choice of a § 2255 remedy.
cite: McDonald v. United States, No. 21-1114 (1st Cir. 2026)
